Hindustan Zinc Approves Major Expansion Plan

Hindustan Zinc has approved an expansion plan worth ₹80,000 crore aimed at nearly doubling its metal production capacity to 2 million tonnes per annum (MTPA). Despite this significant investment and capacity increase, the company's stock has seen a decline.
